## Natural history notes

A small orb-weaving spider characterized by its rounded abdomen, brown to orange coloration, and pale, curved markings that form an arabesque-like pattern. In Florida, it is found in forests, hammocks, fields, gardens, yards, and other areas with shrubs, grasses, or trees for web attachment. It builds circular webs to capture small flying insects and is often active at night or in sheltered vegetation during the day.
